summary: Sandbach United kick off their 2026/27 season this Saturday at home against promotion-chasing Stafford Town, with the club calling on supporters to create a great atmosphere for what promises to be a competitive encounter. The NWCFL is back in action across all divisions after the summer break, with several sides already making strong starts on opening day. Come down and support the Reddies as they look to begin their campaign on a positive note.
